PROVIDER.description: tool + model/version as confirmed in the live UI

STYLE_AUTHORITY.description: lawful rung: movement/palette language, own precedent, or public-domain master — never a named living architect

RATIONALE.description: decision trail incl. decay status and risk flags; grader floor (ruling D-003): >=30 non-whitespace chars, >=6 tokens, >=5 distinct tokens

preserve list.description: ≥1 item when PHOTO=yes; first item = projection/view invariant; the exact item 'N/A — text-only brief; fidelity claims dropped' when PHOTO=no

alter list.description: ≥1 item when PHOTO=yes; an N/A item when PHOTO=no

qa gate.description: ≥5 decidable checkbox lines, each containing a check verb; plus one REJECT-DRIFT RULE line

disclosure.description: required when SCHOOL=yes: caption + reproducible attribution with URL, access date (YYYY-MM-DD), prompt description

tool settings.description: At least one item when PHOTO=yes
